# Recorded by bbb-conform record. Review it with bbb-conform review before committing.
case join.redirect.session-token
target fake

== step 1: call create
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "SUCCESS"
/response/meetingID "${uid}"
/response/internalMeetingID "<sha1(meetingID)>-<time>"
/response/attendeePW "<random>"
/response/moderatorPW "<random>"
/response/createTime "<time>"
/response/messageKey
/response/message

== step 2: call join
status 302
header Content-Type text/html; charset=utf-8
header Set-Cookie JSESSIONID=<token>; HttpOnly; Path=/; Secure
location ${baseUrl}/html5client/join?sessionToken=<token>
body (redirect)

== step 3: presence join as ann
$.ejectReasonCode null
$.ejected null
$.extId "w_<id>"
$.guest false
$.guestStatus "ALLOW"
$.isModerator true
$.joinErrorCode null
$.joinErrorMessage null
$.joined true
$.loggedOut false
$.name "Ann"
$.role "MODERATOR"
$.sessionToken "<token>"
$.userId "w_<id>"

== step 4: call getJoinUrl
status 200
header Content-Type application/json
body json
$.response.message "Join URL provided successfully."
$.response.returncode "SUCCESS"
$.response.url "${baseUrl}${apiPrefix}join?checksum=<token>&fullName=Bob&meetingID=${uid}&redirect=true&role=VIEWER"

== step 5: url ${joinUrl}
status 302
header Content-Type text/html; charset=utf-8
header Set-Cookie JSESSIONID=<token>; HttpOnly; Path=/; Secure
location ${baseUrl}/html5client/join?sessionToken=<token>
body (redirect)
